description: This header file defines function declarations related to interactive rebase in a version control system, including help text appending, todo list editing, and consistency checks.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Adds help information related to the todo list commands into a buffer.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Edits the todo list within a repository, possibly with user interaction.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the consistency between old and new todo lists.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Validates the current todo list against a backup, ensuring consistency.
